name: Finland

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 5635971 inhabitants, recorded as 5.636 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained, but this case documents a closure rather than an absence. The arts academy of Turku University of Applied Sciences long carried the reference course: a large share of Finland's roughly 160 professional puppeteers graduated from it. That course no longer exists as a dedicated programme; puppetry survives there only as electives within the theatre instructor pathway. The Theatre Academy of the University of the Arts likewise offers courses and not a programme. The denominator requires a specialised training, not subjects in a curriculum, so the value moves to 0. The previous 0.5 was the midpoint of an estimated range. This country illustrates exactly the bias the schema flags for this indicator, courses opening and closing with each intake. Caveat: this rests on search summaries without reading curricula at source, hence estimate and an upper bound of 1.
